get.description: Retrieves agent performance metrics for IM sessions. This data provides leads and managers with holistic details into agent performance and can be used for coaching them.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the metrics date range. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: Start of the metrics date range. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the metrics date range. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: End of the metrics date range. Required when duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE or CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS. For CUSTOM_IN_DATE, use dd-mm-yyyy format. For CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, pass the end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration to filter the metrics. Possible values: LAST24HOURS, TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, CUSTOM_IN_DATE, CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, LAST_1_HOUR. When duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE, also pass startDate and endDate as dates in dd-mm-yyyy format. When duration is CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, also pass startDate and endDate as Unix timestamps in milliseconds.

schema.description: Duration to filter the metrics. Possible values: LAST24HOURS, TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, CUSTOM_IN_DATE, CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, LAST_1_HOUR. When duration is CUSTOM_IN_DATE, also pass startDate and endDate as dates in dd-mm-yyyy format. When duration is CUSTOM_IN_MILLIS, also pass startDate and endDate as Unix timestamps in milliseconds.

parameters.name: agentIds
parameters.description: Filter agent metrics for particular agents. Comma-separated list of agent IDs.

schema.description: Filter agent metrics for particular agents. Comma-separated list of agent IDs.

parameters.name: attributeGroup
parameters.description: Denotes which attribute group data is required. For example, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME comes under the RESPONSIVENESS group. Possible values: RESPONSIVENESS

schema.description: Denotes which attribute group data is required. For example, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME comes under the RESPONSIVENESS group. Possible values: RESPONSIVENESS

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Filter session metrics in the given department.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Denotes which metrics are required in the response. This is a list-based parameter; pass one or more comma-separated values. Possible values: ATTENDED_CHATS, AVG_PICKUP_TIME, AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME

schema.description: Denotes which metrics are required in the response. This is a list-based parameter; pass one or more comma-separated values. Possible values: ATTENDED_CHATS, AVG_PICKUP_TIME, AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME

parameters.name: integrationService
parameters.description: Filter metrics for a particular integration service. Possible values: TELEGRAM, TWILIO, IM_TALK, LINE, WECHAT, WHATSAPP, FACEBOOKMESSENGER, INSTAGRAM, WECOM

parameters.name: channelIds
parameters.description: Filter Session metrics by channelId

parameters.name: basedOn
parameters.description: Used to select the required metrics, based on Session Started time or Ended Time. Possible values: START_TIME, END_TIME

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Denotes the dimension in metrics. For example, responsiveness provides how responsive the sessions are in a particular time duration, such as average pickup time. Possible values: RESPONSIVENESS

IMMetricsColumn.description: Metric attribute and value pair object.

attribute.description: Name of the metric attribute. Possible values: ATTENDED_CHATS, AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME, AVG_PICKUP_TIME, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME

value.description: Value of the metric. For ATTENDED_CHATS, a numeric count as a string (for example, "4"). For AVG_PICKUP_TIME, AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME, and AVG_RESPONSE_TIME, a duration in HH:MM:SS format (for example, "00:00:23"). Returns null when no data is available for the metric.

IMMetricsColumnList.description: Array of objects containing metric attribute and value pairs.

IMMetricsRow.description: Agent metrics row object containing metric values for one agent.

values.description: Array of metric value objects for the agent.

id.description: Desk Agent Id for the metrics row.

IMMetricsRowList.description: Array of agent metrics row objects.

IMMetricsEntityDetail.description: Agent profile details associated with a metrics row.

photoURL.description: URL of the agent profile photo.

IMSessionMetric.description: Metric dimension and value pair object.

dimension.description: Name of the metric dimension. Possible values: AVG_PICKUP_TIME, AVG_RESPONSE_TIME, AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME

value.description: Value of the metric. A duration in HH:MM:SS format (for example, "07:57:38"). Returns null when no data is available for the time period.

IMSessionMetricList.description: Array of objects containing metric dimension and value pairs.

data.description: Array of metric data objects for the time period.

time.description: Date or datetime label for the trend data point. When granularity is DAY, the format is yyyy-MM-dd (for example, "2024-11-16"). When granularity is HOURLY, the format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm (for example, "2026-03-12 00:00").

IMSessionTrendDataList.description: Array of objects containing time-series trend data entries.

IMMetrics.description: Retrieves agent performance metrics for IM sessions. This data provides leads and managers with holistic details into agent performance and can be used for coaching them.

schema.description: Agent metrics response object containing per-agent metric rows and agent profile details.

data.description: Array of per-agent metric rows for the requested duration, attribute group, and filters.

entityDetails.description: Agent profile details keyed by agent ZUID.

entity.description: Entity type for the metrics. Possible values: AGENT

SessionTimeSeriesMetrics.description: Retrieves session-related metrics such as average first response time, average response time, and average pickup time, with time-series granularity.

schema.description: Session time-series metrics response object containing aggregated metrics and trend data points.

aggregatedMetrics.description: Array of aggregated metric value objects across the entire duration.

trendDataList.description: Array of trend data objects with time-series metric data points.
